method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); one date helper in a small module, the rules in one module and the family member's questions in a seat module importing it; two regulative rules (the executor's 6 months, s 8(1); the particulars, s 7) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Fatal Accidents Act 1934 (Tas), No. 30 of 1934, consolidated version published 2019-10-31 and current at point in time 2026-11-06, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-1934-030.txt (text sha256 baa67c17e231ce850eb9947a46061ac5950722247d18d8bb970c4361a1a4e426), retrieved from legislation.tas.gov.au on 2026-11-06

seat: the member of the family: the spouse, partner, parent, stepparent, grandparent, child, stepchild, grandchild, brother, sister, half-brother or half-sister of a person whose death was caused by a wrongful act, neglect or default, for whose benefit the action is brought and who brings it in his or her own name where s 8 allows (tfa-seat.l4)

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics were read; satisfied assertions were counted by distinct source range. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Focus: the provisions a claimant meets. The whole Act: ss 2(2), 3, 4, 5, 6(1), 7, 8, 9, 10. Out: s 1 (short title), s 2(1) (Crown bound: machinery); ss 3A, 6(2), (3), Schedule 1 (repealed or omitted). The time limit is not in this Act (Limitation Act 1974 (Tas) ss 5A, 5B, encoded separately). Reasons in NOTES.md.
